title: TripOptimizationRequest
description: Request body sent from the UI to the OR itinerary optimizer. The OR model uses this payload together with static files under data/OR_data/ to compute an attraction visit order and metro legs.

request_id.description: Optional client-generated id for logging, tracing, and pairing with the OR response.

trip_date.description: Travel date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Used to look up weather_daily and daily-level rain/heat adjustments.

day_type.description: Matches day_type in train_frequency_by_time.csv and station_crowd_by_time.csv. Use holiday for weekends and public holidays when those tables use the holiday profile.

start_time.description: Trip departure time in 24-hour HH:MM local time. Used to map time slots for wait time and crowd penalties.

end_time.description: Trip must finish by this time (HH:MM). OR treats this as a hard time budget together with per-attraction stay minutes.

start_station_id.description: Origin station code (e.g. G16). Must exist in station_pair_routes / station_info.

end_station_id.description: Return or final station code. Can equal start_station_id for round-trip day tours.

attractions.description: User-selected attractions for this run. The OR model optimizes visit order over this set; it does not search the full 801-POI catalog unless allow_skip_attractions is enabled.

budget_yen.description: Maximum total metro fare (JPY) for station-to-station legs, excluding optional non-metro costs.

stay_minutes.description: Planned on-site stay duration at this attraction in minutes.

must_visit.description: If true, the attraction cannot be dropped when allow_skip_attractions is enabled.

time_weight.description: Weight for total travel + wait time in the objective. Weights are typically normalized to sum to 1.

fare_weight.description: Weight for total metro fare in the objective.

crowd_weight.description: Weight for station crowd proxy (station_crowd_by_time.crowd_score) along the route.

avoid_rain.description: If true, increase walking and outdoor-attraction penalties using weather_daily on trip_date (rain_severity, rain_mm).

rain_penalty_weight.description: Extra objective weight applied when avoid_rain is true. Ignored when avoid_rain is false.

max_transfers.description: Maximum allowed transfers per metro leg (from station_pair_routes.transfer_count).

include_wait_time.description: If true, add avg_wait_time_min from train_frequency_by_time.csv to leg costs.

allow_skip_attractions.description: If true, OR may drop non-must_visit attractions when time or budget is infeasible.

prefer_indoor_on_rain.description: When avoid_rain is true and rain is non-trivial, penalize outdoor categories (park, shrine outdoor areas, etc.). Exact category mapping is handled in the OR preprocessor.
